craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of means — the yogi chapter: powerful stand → decayed thoughts → recorded calling → goddess-voiced reward → doubled reflecting → distraction-proof shining → mantra-strong → sporting-stayed → unbroken wonder. Thinking-nothing decays-thoughts; enamoured kept (love-word in decay verse). Rejected: (a) enamoured→devoted → killed: enamoured keeps eros. Read aloud: FROM-think-ing NO-thing, THOUGHTS de-CAY — SO-may-IT-be … EN-am-oured THERE, IN-be-ing's-FIELD.

lines: From thinking nothing, thoughts decay — so may it be;
from knowing-awareness, play-power, enamoured there, in being's field.
l4.sanskrit_cite: akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet | cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale

reads_against.argmap: How do thoughts decay? → Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; playful power attached in being.
c1_essence: Middle-opening means powerful thought-decay, many ways.
Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; play-power enamoured in being.
Attached sees bright flood; tightening brahma-called.
Goddess speaks; strong win reward in days.
Impressed roamer reflects again and again.
Sporting yogi mantra-stayed, strong playing power-swollen.
